description: Use the released organization preset while retaining development-container coverage. Custom regex managers track the reporter tag in verifications/settings.toml and the robot release refs in verifications/*.toml. Lock files are generator output.

packageRules.description: Coordinate verifier workflow and hallway image proposals; the engineering lead generates locked evidence before merge.
prBodyNotes: Completion required for workflow-only, image-only, digest-only and grouped updates. Select one published capability-verifier vX.Y.Z release, then run `python3 tools/update_verifier.py --tag vX.Y.Z` on this branch. It coordinates workflow SHA, devcontainer digest, README example and every lock through `python3 tools/lock.py --update` logic and checks that the tag uniquely identifies the verifier commit; evaluator follows only that release declaration, robot/reporter pins stay unchanged. Hosted Mend Renovate cannot execute our lock generator; grouping does not guarantee matching releases. Review the generated diff, commit with a `fix:` or `chore:` prefix, and require exact-head fresh-resolution checks and every verification pipeline. The engineering lead may merge once those required checks pass on the exact head SHA and verification evidence is recorded. A human approval is not a merge gate. See README.md, Updating the verifier. Never hand-edit hashes or bypass a failing guard.

Bundle completion uses `python3 tools/update_bundle.py --verifier vX.Y.Z` or `--reporter vX.Y.Z` from trusted main. Hosted Mend proposes pins only. The repository writer remains disabled until its credential and queue-gate audit are approved. Do not reset custom/completion commits or request a destructive Renovate rebase. See docs/bundle-automation.md.

packageRules.description: Reporter release tags stay on the organization policy. Renovate edits only verifications/settings.toml.
prBodyNotes: Completion required. This proposal changes only the reporter release tag in verifications/settings.toml. Renovate does not edit the verifications/*.lock.json files, their hashes, or robot, verifier or evaluator pins. Regenerate every lock with the existing generator: `python3 tools/lock.py verifications/<definition>.toml` for each definition. Never hand-edit hashes, commits or digests. `python3 tools/lock.py --update` refreshes the verifier and scenario evaluator and leaves the reporter pin as committed, so it does not complete this proposal. Review the generated diff and commit it with a fix: or chore: prefix. Record the published wheel sha256 in tools/install_reporter.py the same way existing tags are recorded; that is the wheel hash, not a lock hash. Automerge stays off.

Bundle completion uses `python3 tools/update_bundle.py --verifier vX.Y.Z` or `--reporter vX.Y.Z` from trusted main. Hosted Mend proposes pins only. The repository writer remains disabled until its credential and queue-gate audit are approved. Do not reset custom/completion commits or request a destructive Renovate rebase. See docs/bundle-automation.md.

packageRules.description: Robot release refs stay on the organization policy. Renovate edits only verifications/*.toml definitions.
prBodyNotes: Completion required. This proposal updates only `[robot].ref` in `verifications/*.toml`. Renovate does not edit `verifications/*.lock.json` or `.github/workflows/verify.yml`. Hosted Mend Renovate cannot run `tools/lock.py` (`postUpgradeTasks` requires administrator `allowedCommands`). Regenerate each affected lock with `python3 tools/lock.py verifications/<definition>.toml`, update the matching job `ref:` commit in `.github/workflows/verify.yml` to the resolved robot commit, and verify with `pytest tests/test_locks.py`. Never hand-edit hashes or commits. Automerge stays off.

packageRules.description: The verification locks are generator output. Renovate must not edit them.
